notes: Genuine 'New Arrivals' PLP found at https://www.structube.com/en_ca/new (nav label 'NEW', GraphQL category id 235). Meta_title is explicitly 'New arrivals - modern furniture and home decor'; meta_description 'Discover our new exclusive home accents at affordable prices'; on-page copy 'Update your house with our new furniture and home decor!' -- unambiguous genuine New Arrivals concept, not a marketing/editorial-only page (it is a real filterable/sortable PLP with FILTERS/SORT BY controls). Has two children with their own URLs: 'new/furniture-new' (id 543) and 'new/decor-new' (id 544). Rendered every page directly with Playwright (not just GraphQL) to cross-check: parent /en_ca/new shows '1 - 1 of 1 items' (GraphQL products.total_count for category_id=235 also =1 -- exact match, no discrepancy); child /new/furniture-new shows the identical single product (GIULIA dining table) and also '1 - 1 of 1 items'; child /new/decor-new shows '0 items' / 'THERE ARE NO PRODUCTS MATCHING THIS SELECTION' (GraphQL total_count=0, confirmed). Since the parent's single product IS the Furniture child's single product (not a genuine multi-child rollup, and the Decor child is empty), only the parent row is emitted per 'drop zero-qty children, do not invent/pad sub-structure' -- emitting both parent and Furniture-child rows would double count the same lone product. The catalogue-wide New Arrivals listing is currently very small (only 1 SKU); this was verified twice (GraphQL API and live rendered page, both English and via the French sitemap's 'nouveautes' alias confirming the same node) so it is reported as-is rather than treated as an error. No other New-Arrivals-style pages found (checked 'New Collection'/'Just In'/'Latest' wording plus FR sitemap 'nouveautes' -- all resolve to this same /new category). Sale, Open Box, Small Budget, Top Value, Premium nav items are unrelated (price tiers / outlet / promo, not New Arrivals).
